title: Geometric properties
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and $X$ a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base]. $X$ is
*geometrically irreducible* (resp. *geometrically reduced*,
*geometrically connected*, *geometrically integral*) over $k$
if $X_{k'}$ is irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components] (resp. reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme], connected [def-weil-connected-scheme], integral [def-pc-integral-scheme]) for
every field extension $k'/k$ [def-pc-field-extension], where $X_{k'}=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec} k}\operatorname{Spec}(k')$
([def-pc-base-change]) is the base change along $\operatorname{Spec}k'\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum].
